limitations.note: The square-wave counter still resets at 20 instead of 19, leaving the period at 21 clocks instead of 20.
The rewrite forces an immediate square-wave level on mode entry instead of holding the previous output until a threshold, and changes the triangle's first post-reset sample from 31 to 1.
The test passed because it expected the same incorrect 21-clock square-wave period that the fix retained.
